name: @maestro/host-callback-bridge
description: Host-boot callback bridge (polyfill lane): binds HTTP /callback at host startup, watches bridge inbox.log with fs.watch (no polling), routes each line per registry.json to the target session via loopback /api/session.prompt (ORCA-CB envelope). Replaces the session-owned link (SI-003): the orchestrator session only consumes turns. Source of truth: maestro-preset repo plugins/host-callback-bridge; deployed face: ~/.dsh/plugins/host-callback-bridge (self-contained copy, dev-sync --polyfill).
